text:
alex: Heads-up — console quota matrix change landed on staging and it's changing how quota attribution maps to SDK headers. If you rely on client-side route tags, you'll see different buckets.
maria: @alex can you summarise the delta? is this a behavioral change for the Python/TS SDKs or just console mapping?
alex: It's mostly attribution mapping: we collapsed the old per-route buckets into a 3-tier matrix (fast/premium/standard) and SDKs that were writing custom route headers won't map 1:1 anymore. SDKs that use the canonical 'x-rd-route' header will continue to map to the same tier.
jamal: Wait, so this will break existing customers who set arbitrary route names via the SDK? any fallback planned?
alex: Yes, corner-case customers might see their quota moved. Plan: we add a compatibility shim in the console that translates legacy route names to matrix tiers for 30 days while we coordinate SDK updates.
rachel: From Console side, we can enable translation flag per-tenant. But need the SDK teams to start emitting 'x-rd-policy:matrix-v2' when they bump. That header will be the signal to opt-in into the new mapping.
maria: For DevEx: can we get a clear SDK contract? jamal, what's the effort to add x-rd-policy:matrix-v2 in py/ts/go SDKs and a graceful fallback?
jamal: For python and ts it's a small change: add header toggle in client config defaulting to off. Go needs a semver minor. We can do a patch to accept the new header but keep old behavior unless users flip it.
alex: Timeline: console side will enable translation shim on Monday for staging. SDKs should have opt-in flag by EOD Friday so we can test interop.
deploy-bot: deploy started: console/translate-shim staging rollout (10%)
rachel: Also need telemetry: create a console dashboard tile showing how many requests hit translation shim vs native mapping. That will guide the rollback decision.
jamal: We'll emit telemetry tag 'sdk_policy:v2' in request traces when the header present. Also add metric 'sdk.policy.matrix_v2.count'.
maria: Docs: add snippet to quickstart showing toggling the header and the expected mapping table. Also include rollback steps for customers who rely on old names.
alex: One more thing: tests — please add an e2e between SDK sandbox + staging console to verify no quota drift for a set of sample route names.
jamal: I'll open PRs for python and ts today: py bump 1.12.3 -> 1.13.0 (feature flag), ts bump 2.8.0 -> 2.9.0. Go will follow next week.
rachel: Sounds good. @jamal please ping when PRs are ready and we'll flip a tenant to matrix-v2 to validate.
jamal: Will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
